programs.title: Better Homes And Gardens
programs.desc: As the size of the block of land for the traditional Aussie home decreases, so too does the habitat for our pollinating bugs. But thankfully Melissa is here to help us lure them back with a bug hotel.

programs.title: Escape To The Country
programs.desc: With a budget of 400,000 pounds, Jules Hudson is house hunting with a couple who are seeking a new rural life in Cheshire.

programs.title: Bargain Hunt
programs.desc: Amateur antique collectors go head-to-head to make the greatest profit at auction.

programs.title: Heartbeat
programs.desc: Abandoned by his wife and faced with financial ruin, local farmer Richard Harvey finally reaches the end of his tether, and heads into Aidensfield to air his grievances in a particularly memorable way. Meanwhile, the arrival of a handsome stranger sets Gina's heart racing - but he could be a dangerous criminal. Vernon and David branch out into a new line of business, and soon manage to pep up a few palates with Aunt Beth's tangy horseradish sauce.

programs.title: McDonald And Dodds
programs.desc: Ian Andrews is on the local bus and everything is as usual, but when the bus rolls into Bath station, he dies; to solve the mystery of Ian's death, McDonald and Dodds must delve into the history of blues music and the shady world of art auctions.

programs.title: Air Crash Investigations: The Accident Files
programs.desc: Mistaken identity and hostile fire over enemy territory are among the many risks that pilots face in war zones around the world. An Iranian passenger plane is blown out of the sky by a missile fired from a US warship. A tragic explosion rocks a massive military plane carrying Vietnamese orphans to safety. And, a cargo flight is crippled by a surface-to-air missile over wartorn Iraq.
